title: Bias–variance with the right source of randomness
promptMarkdown: At a fixed x, f*(x)=4, test-noise variance is0.50, and repeated independently sampled training datasets produce a fitted predictor with mean 3.5 and variance 0.20. Derive expected test squared error using an independent fresh noise term. A second procedure has mean 3.9 and variance 0.60; compare risks. Explain why running twenty initialisation seeds on one fixed dataset does not by itself estimate the same dataset variance.
hintLadder: Add and subtract the predictor expectation.
Name the independence needed for the noise cross term.
Changing an optimiser seed leaves the observations fixed.
